EXIST Business Start-up Grant

The EXIST Business Start-up Grant supports students, graduates and scientists from universities and research institutions who can apply to prepare an innovative, technology-based business start-up.

Who is eligible?

Students, graduates and researchers are eligible and can apply individually or in teams of up to three persons.

The start-up must not yet have been founded; support is provided before the company is founded.

The university or research institution must support the start-up project and host the team for the funding period.

What is funded?

  • Personal living expenses: graduates receive €2,500 per month, students €1,000 per month, and holders of a doctorate €3,000 per month.
  • Material expenses up to €10,000 for individual founders and up to €30,000 for teams.
  • Coaching up to €5,000.

Funding is provided for up to 12 months.

How to apply

The application must be submitted through the start-up service of the university or research institution to Projektträger Jülich.

Applications can be submitted at any time; there is no fixed deadline.
